summary: Dorsey voted no on San Francisco's January 2024 resolution calling for an immediate and sustained ceasefire in Gaza. In September 2026 he shared an op-ed framing Gaza's post-Hamas future as nation-building and coexistence with a Jewish Israel, and called 'from the river to sea' chants destructive. Blocking a local ceasefire call and then endorsing a Jewish-state coexistence model while delegitimizing a central Palestinian demand place his recorded position squarely on the pro-Israel side of the conflict.
